answer_1.quote: We explore three use cases: story generation, text summarization and investigating multilingual LLM behavior...
answer_1.outputs: generated stories, emails, reviews, and summaries

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we compute precision/recall/F1 scores.

answer_3.quote: For the LLM-based methods, we used the prompt You are given texts from two different groups. Please identify words or phrases that are systematically different between the texts of the two groups.

answer_4.quote: We ran a user study to evaluate how difficult it is for users to identify significant differences and if they can leverage token patterns.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to describe the differences in free-text form.
